identification: Framed display: red Squier (Fender) Stratocaster-style guitar with about 4 faint signatures on scratchplate (claimed U2), Joshua Tree LP and sleeve, band photo, two plaques. Helping Hand Group (Mascot NSW charity auctions) COA no. 16575, which guarantees the autograph but is not a third-party authenticator (not JSA, PSA, Beckett or REAL). Entry-level Squier guitar, so value is almost all in the signatures, which are unverified.
